[TODO:ja] You see Jesus on the road.
A question burns inside you.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Run past, too proud to ask

pride_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] Do Not Walk On
pride_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] The question will not leave you.

to inherit eternal life?"

choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Truth is not bought with haste.

Let him speak.

since I was a boy."

Your wealth holds you back.

Remember what you felt.
